items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: Ramsey Lewis, the girl that made “Street Life.” John Levy managed her too. Jazz Crusaders he managed.

ctx.x: And you’re going back there very soon.

Tomorrow. Tomorrow, for the marathon. I’d like to live there, at the Jenkins Orphanage in Charleston, South Carolina. A lot of people you know and love either went there or passed through. And Roy Eldridge used to stop by Daniel Jenkins all the time. Lionel Hampton had a trumpet player in the band, used to always send me messages. He’s way ahead of me by ten, eleven years. “Tell that boy to keep on playin’.” His name was Eddie Williams, the Lionel Hampton Band. He called himself “King Ed.” Because they really…
